title: Better Pumpkins
description: Tired of the pumpkin glare? Then this resource pack is for you)
body: **Imagine a situation:** you're in hardcore or you're going **to the end**, but you've got a **pumpkin with the curse of non-semblance on it. It doesn't matter!** This resource pack will **help you a lot in this!** It removes the **glare from the pumpkin** and **makes the screen more spacious.**
